structured.answer: I won't decide anything yet. I'll ask my son and then the bank. A deposit pays interest for a fixed time, the state takes 15% of the interest, and if you break it early the bank charges a fine that it sets itself. The page's own example showed less money "in today's money" than I put in (68,270 vs 70,000), and it says Israel has no deposit insurance, so it worried me more than it reassured me.
